title: Built-in language rules for AI translation
summary: New translation memories follow built-in rules for the target language, including numbers and plurals, in AI translation, review and QE reports.

items.title: Built-in rules for 1,175 languages.
items.body: New VitraTM memories now follow built-in rules for the target language, including how it writes numbers and plurals, in AI translation, the review pass and QE reports. It works with or without a linked style guide.

children.body: Your own style guide rules come after the built-in ones and win where they disagree.
The built-in rules show alongside yours in the memory's style guide.
Memories created before this release keep translating as they did.
